description: Step 1 of transactional email setup: create a sending subdomain (such as mail.example.com) of a verified domain of the organization. Returns dns_records to publish at the DNS host; then verify the domain, create a transactional sender on it, and send with a message send or an SMTP credential. Calling it again with the same values resumes a setup that stopped part way.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

root_domain.description: A verified domain of the organization, such as example.com.

subdomain.description: One DNS label: mail sends from mail.example.com.

name: shipmail_create_transactional_domain

dns_records.description: The records to publish at the DNS host before verifying. Empty while setup has not finished.

title: Create Transactional Domain
